question.text: In an unbiased p - n junction electrons diffuse from n-region to p-region because:

options.text: electrons travel across the junction due to potential difference
only electrons move from n to p region and not the vice - versa
electron concentration in n - region is more as compared to that in p - region
holes in p - region attract them

solution.text: In a <math><mi>p</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>n</mi></math> junction diffusion occurs due to spontaneous movement of majority charge carrier from the region of high concentration to low concentration.
